instructions:
Stealth Chromium driver with 5 tools: act (interact), see (read/extract), state (tabs/cookies/storage/sessions/block), run (branching/looping plans), vision (screenshots, last resort; path= saves the PNG, size= sets the viewport, full= the whole page).
FAST PATTERNS (collapse round-trips): (1) Read or scrape a URL in ONE call with see(url=..., mode="content" | extract="auto", format="json", block="images,fonts"). (2) Interactive task: act(navigate) returns refs + content preview; act by ref/text/label/selector directly; every action returns a verified verdict + delta so a follow-up see is rarely needed. (3) Multi-field forms: act(fill, fields=[...], submit=...) in one call; type+press="Enter" submits search bars. (4) Straight sequences: act(batch, slim=true); branching/loops/JSON receipts: run(steps=[...]). (5) Arm act(dialog, expect=...) BEFORE clicking triggers that open confirm()/prompt(). (6) Inspect APIs with see(logs="xhr", format="json"); check HTTP/console errors with see(logs="network"|"console", format="json").
CONTRACTS: Refs self-heal within a page; refresh after navigation or tab switch. Pick ONE read kind per see call (never mix extract= with mode/logs/find/scope). Large payloads offload to {artifact,bytes,next_offset:0} — page via see(artifact=..., items=true for JSON arrays). Navigation errors include exact HTTP status (e.g. HTTP 429 + Retry-After) and current page state; non-empty 4xx/5xx pages attach an http: notice. Never blind-retry a submit or mutation with degraded:true — inspect destination first.
HOST: {{HOST_NOTE}}

tools.name: act
tools.description:
Interact; returns verified verdict + delta (navigate adds refs + content preview). Prefer ref > text/label > selector; click x,y overrides targets. Refs self-heal on-page; refresh after nav/tab switch. Ambiguity returns candidate refs (pick ref/selector/nth). Popups keep opener active; switch-tab by returned ID.
Actions — Nav: navigate(url,block?), back, forward, reload. Input: click, type(replaces+verifies; press=Enter submits once), clear, select(option), press(key/chord; targeted focuses first), fill(multi-field + opt submit), hover, scroll(dx/dy), upload(ref|selector + text=path). Wait/Inspect: wait(condition + text|selector|js), read(live value/toggle/select options; format=json), dialog(arm expect= before trigger), eval(js; ref|selector binds el; format=json). Data/Files: extract, paginate(next,max,extract), collect(url,max), download(url; body:true for <=32MiB HTTP body), pdf. Compose: batch(sequential steps, incl. see/extract/state; optional:true continues runtime failure; slim inherits).
url= navigates first (except download/collect/state). Plans validate before effects (<=1000 steps, depth <=32); runtime failures keep prior effects. Errors include page state + HTTP status (e.g. 429 + Retry-After). trusted:false = untrusted fallback; degraded:true = unknown outcome — inspect before retrying mutations. Quiet clicks never replay.

body.description: download: raw HTTP body (<=32MiB/30s, no cookies; HTTP(S) OBU_PROXY) vs browser attachment.

condition.description: wait: element/text/title/url use text=; selector uses selector=; js uses js=; settle=DOM quiet; network=300ms idle.

fields.description: fill: [{ref|label|selector, role?, nth?, text|option|check}]. Toggles use check=true/false (omit to toggle).

js.description: eval: JS (ref/selector binds el). wait/if/while condition=js: expression.

key.description: Key/chord: Enter, Tab, Escape, Backspace, ArrowDown, Control+a, Meta+Enter, Shift+Tab.

max.description: collect: max items (default 100); paginate: max pages (default 5, max 100).

next.description: paginate: CSS selector or text=/label=/ref= prefix.

nth.description: 1-based match index; out of range refuses with count.

press.description: type: key/chord sent once after verified typing (e.g. Enter).

prompt_text.description: dialog: text for prompt() when accepting.

ref.description: Element ID (e.g. e5); self-heals on-page, refresh after nav/tab switch.

role.description: Role filter (button, textbox, link, checkbox, combobox, etc.).

selector.description: CSS selector (open shadows; wait also checks same-origin frames). Hidden targets refuse.

slim.description: Verdict-only on success (batch/run inherit); reads/errors keep detail.

steps.description: batch: act/see/extract/state steps (no nested batch). optional:true continues runtime failure.

submit.description: fill: submit ref, text, or selector=/ref=/text= prefix (dispatched once).

text.description: click/hover: visible text; type: replacement value; upload: file path; wait: match text.

url.description: Target URL for navigate/download/collect; on other non-state actions, navigates first.

x.description: click: viewport CSS px (supply x and y; overrides targets).

tools.name: see
tools.description:
Read page state, text, data, logs, or artifacts. Pass url= (opt block=) to open+read in ONE call. One read per call (never mix extract= with mode/logs/find/scope).
Modes: model (default: refs, opt filter=), content (Markdown, opt scope=eN), outline (headings). Structured: extract=auto (site-aware: Reddit/X/GitHub/HN/products; preview=true samples fields), extract=json (+ template), extract=links|forms. Search/Diff: find= (controls+refs or text location), changes=true (model delta), scope=eN (subtree). Logs: console (doc), network (nav), xhr (API/fetch URLs + header names); clear=true reads+clears.
format=json returns pure JSON for extract=, artifact=, changes=true, find=, and logs= ({data,note} with notices). Oversized payloads return {artifact,bytes,next_offset:0}: page via artifact= + offset/limit (concat char chunks, or items=true for array rows until next_offset=null).

artifact.description: Offloaded payload path. Page with offset/limit (concat char chunks, or items=true for array rows).

block.description: With url=: images,fonts,media,trackers to skip during load.

changes.description: Model delta since last capture (supports format=json).

content.description: model only: append visible text (prefer mode=content).

extract.description: auto (site-aware; Reddit posts fetch full tree with complete/partial), json (+ template), links, forms.

find.description: Search controls by text -> refs + scores (or text location). Supports format=json.

format.description: text (default) | json — pure JSON for extract=, artifact=, changes=true, find=, logs=.

items.description: artifact: page JSON array rows instead of char chunks.

limit.description: extract max items (default 50; Reddit <=1000). artifact: chars (default 20000) or rows with items=true (default 50).

logs.description: console (doc: logs, uncaught errors + stack, failed loads), network (nav), xhr (API/fetch endpoints). All support format=json.

mode.description: model (default): refs. content: Markdown. outline: headings.

offset.description: artifact start char (or row with items=true). Default 0.

scope.description: Ref ID (e.g. e5) subtree text (Markdown with mode=content).

template.description: extract=json: {"items":{"container":"css","fields":{"k":"css|css@attr"}}}. Rendered text by default (hidden in _omitted; {"sel":"css","raw":true} reads hidden). Spans open shadows + same-origin frames.

url.description: Optional URL — opens first so you navigate+read in ONE call.

tools.name: state
tools.description: Manage tabs, cookies, storage, sessions, blocking, and compression. Tabs: tabs, open-tab(url — opens+switches, returns target_id), switch-tab/close-tab(target_id), opt slim:true. Cookies: cookies(url?/domain?), set-cookie(name,value,scope/flags), del-cookie(name). Storage: ls/ss, set-ls/set-ss(name,value — empty string valid), rm-ls/rm-ss(name), clear-ls/clear-ss. Sessions: save/load(name — navigate to origin before load, then reload). Perf: block(classes or clear:true; inert assets only), compress(mode=on|off|status). Reads preserve full values (offloading if large). In batch/run use {action:"state",op,...}.

clear.description: block: true clears rules. Omit classes/clear to read blocked-request count.

name.description: Cookie name, storage key, or session name.

slim.description: open/switch/close-tab: return tab ID only, omit page model.

url.description: open-tab URL, cookie scope (set/del-cookie), or cookies filter.

value.description: Cookie or storage value (empty string allowed).

tools.name: run
tools.description:
Execute multi-step browser plans in ONE call with if/while branching, inline see/extract/state reads, and optional structured JSON receipts. Use `act batch` for simple linear steps; use `run` for conditions, loops, or format=json step receipts.
Steps reuse act/see/state fields (fill/eval/url/block included) plus optional:true (continues runtime failure locally, incl. nested steps). Control flow: {action:"if",condition,text|selector|js,then:[...],else:[...]}, {action:"while",condition,text|selector|js,steps:[...],max:10} (exit test required; max 0-100), or wait+else (runs else on timeout). Validated statically before any effect (<=1000 steps, depth <=32). Runtime errors halt and keep prior effects/observations (failed batch halts enclosing run). slim inherits; reads and errors stay full.

format.description: json: {status:completed|stopped,results:[{step,status:ok|optional_failed|failed,output,error?}],stopped_at?,error?,page?,note?}. Set each read step's format explicitly.

slim.description: Inherit verdict-only actions; keep reads and errors.

steps.description: Steps reuse act/see/state fields plus optional:true, if/while, and wait+else.

condition.description: Same as act wait; js= expression, selector= CSS, text= text/title/url.

tools.name: vision
tools.description: PNG screenshot for visual checks, canvas/image UIs, or layout debugging when act/see cannot answer. marks=true paints numbered ref badges on visible main-frame controls without mutating page DOM. Inline unless path= names a file; oversized PNGs offload to an artifact path. Also a run step. Prefer act/see for normal browsing.

marks.description: Overlay numbered ref badges (Set-of-Marks) on visible controls.

path.description: Write the .png here; no inline image.
